assumptions: A subtree carrying BOTH CLAUDE.md and docs/specs/ intends to own its artifacts — the convention observed in the field report
Restoring scope-guard/read-guard matching is desired even though it means they begin blocking edits they previously let through
risks: Restored guards change behavior for anyone working under a mismatched path spelling — they will start seeing scope-guard advisories that were previously silent
A repo that happens to have a subtree CLAUDE.md + docs/specs without intending subtree ownership would newly resolve there; MTK_ARTIFACT_ROOT and the explicit marker are the escape hatches
